name: Bubble Wand
desc: Pops the sleepy bubbles that block a path. Just walk into them!

name: Glow Lantern
desc: Its warm light melts Hush fog as you walk through it.

name: Hop Boots
desc: Springy boots that carry you over gaps.

name: Echo Whistle
desc: One clear note wakes the old echo gates.

name: Tide Charm
desc: Water calms under your feet so you can walk across.

name: Star Compass
desc: It always points to the Star Archive, and opens its gate.

name: Spark Berry
desc: A sweet, glowing berry. Creatures love them.

name: Brass Gear
desc: A little gear that fell off something bigger.

name: Dew Crystal
desc: Morning dew that decided to stay.

name: Lost Page
desc: A page that slipped out of an old book.

name: Old Map Piece
desc: A corner of a map of Lumeria.

name: Gear Badge
desc: A badge for tinkerers who count carefully.

name: Ink Ribbon
desc: A ribbon for story savers.

name: Leaf Pin
desc: A pin for patient growers.

name: Atlas Pin
desc: A pin for people who know their way around.

name: Friendship Bookmark
desc: A gift from the First Archivist. It marks your place in every story.

name: Rocket Skates
desc: Tiny rockets on the heels. You zip around much faster!

name: Wind Glider
desc: A light folding wing. It carries you across wind gaps.

name: Skyberry Fizz
desc: A bubbly potion. For 45 seconds you float across wind gaps.

name: Hover Skiff
desc: A little hovering boat. It rides over water and straight across rushing rapids.

name: Gadget Drill
desc: A spinning drill. Walk into rubble and it clears the way.

name: Sky Whistle
desc: Blow it and Captain Pip's wind-boat carries you to any place you have visited.
